tour.intro.title: Before you dive in
tour.intro.body:
This site produces a daily assessment of civilian resilience on the Israeli homefront. Each day it gathers news coverage, regional radio broadcasts, field reports from population-behavior officers, community visits, social-media activity, field surveys, and search trends, and consolidates them into a single analytical picture.

The assessment is organized into eight resilience components. Each component is presented as a short analytical narrative in plain language, and every claim is grounded in cited evidence you can open and judge for yourself. The scope switches between the national picture and a focused view of northern Israel, and earlier editions remain available for comparison.

One thing to keep in mind: this app is not a source of truth — it is a decision-support system, meant to inform your judgement, not replace it.

In the built-in chat you can ask questions about any report, the raw data behind it, temporal trends, and analyses — answers cite the underlying evidence. The short tour ahead shows where each of these elements lives.

tour.mainShell.welcome.title: Welcome
tour.mainShell.welcome.body: This quick tour shows you around the daily homefront resilience assessment. It takes under a minute — you can leave at any time with Esc.
tour.mainShell.scope-toggle.title: National or North
tour.mainShell.scope-toggle.body: Switch the assessment scope between the national picture and a focused view of northern Israel.
tour.mainShell.edition-picker.title: Browse report editions
tour.mainShell.edition-picker.body: Open earlier report editions to compare how the picture has evolved day by day.
tour.mainShell.report-contents.title: Jump to a component
tour.mainShell.report-contents.body: The assessment is organized into resilience components. Use this list to jump straight to the one you need.
tour.mainShell.component-narrative.title: The component narrative
tour.mainShell.component-narrative.body: Each component opens into a short analytical narrative — the day's assessment in plain words. Here is a real example from a past report.
tour.mainShell.component-evidence.title: The evidence behind it
tour.mainShell.component-evidence.body: Beneath every narrative sits its evidence list — the cited items behind each claim, grouped by source. Open any item to judge it for yourself.
tour.mainShell.data-sources.title: Explore the raw data
tour.mainShell.data-sources.body: Every claim in the assessment traces back to raw sources, organized in these tabs. Let's take a quick look at each one.
tour.mainShell.source-pbo-reports.title: PBO reports
tour.mainShell.source-pbo-reports.body: Daily situation reports from municipal and regional population-behavior officers on the ground.
tour.mainShell.source-report-bot.title: Report bot
tour.mainShell.source-report-bot.body: Structured field reports submitted through the reporting bot.
tour.mainShell.source-visits.title: Visits
tour.mainShell.source-visits.body: Notes and observations from in-person visits to communities and local institutions.
tour.mainShell.source-news.title: News
tour.mainShell.source-news.body: Homefront coverage collected daily from national and local news sites.
tour.mainShell.source-radio.title: Radio
tour.mainShell.source-radio.body: Transcribed broadcasts from regional radio stations — local voices, in their own words.
tour.mainShell.source-social-media.title: Social media
tour.mainShell.source-social-media.body: Citizen posts and discussions from social networks and Telegram channels.
tour.mainShell.source-pools.title: Field surveys
tour.mainShell.source-pools.body: Field survey data gathered through Google Forms — structured questionnaires answered by people on the ground.
tour.mainShell.source-trends.title: Trends
tour.mainShell.source-trends.body: What people search for online — anonymized search trends reflect public mood and concerns.
tour.mainShell.write-report.title: Write a field report
tour.mainShell.write-report.body: Share structured observations from the field. Opens in a separate window.
tour.mainShell.send-evidence.title: Send evidence
tour.mainShell.send-evidence.body: Contribute a photo, link, or note — submissions feed the daily assessment. Opens in a separate window.
tour.mainShell.chat.title: The built-in chat
tour.mainShell.chat.body: Ask questions in your own words about any report, the raw data behind it, temporal trends, and analyses — answers cite the underlying evidence.
tour.mainShell.finale.title: You're all set
tour.mainShell.finale.body: Replay this tour anytime from this menu or from the site footer.
